scenarios.title: Same report, no photo
scenarios.text: I'm sure I saw the person at Federation Square in a grey hoodie around 2pm.

scenarios.why: Location and timing are fine, but the description contradicts the profile. Identity evidence scales the score down, so a well-located report about someone else cannot rank like a match.
